title: High consistency of regional cortical thinning in aging across multiple samples
summary: Six samples,883 participants; consistent age-related cortical thinning. Strongest reported in superior/inferior frontal and superior temporal regions; inferior temporal/anterior cingulate relatively less affected.
comparison_policy: Compare direction descriptively only after host verification; inferiortemporal uses the DKT label of that name, medial temporal is an extra observation rather than a substitute. No one-to-one temporoparietal junction mapping or replication claim.
